_comment: Occupant density informed by ASHRAE 62.1 Table 6-1 (warehouse ~2 people/1000 ft^2 -- sparse, bulk storage floor is mostly unoccupied) and DOE/NREL Commercial Reference Building Models (Deru et al. 2011) non-refrigerated Warehouse prototype (~52,000 ft^2, 1 floor, distinct office vs. bulk-storage schedule sets -- this repo models one blended occupant count, not separate zones). Illustrative, not survey-calibrated.
description: Warehouse / bulk storage with a small admin office. Weekday shift, closed weekends.
